content: परिक्षिप् €6 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To surround; गङ्गास्रोतःपरिक्षिप्तम् <ls>Ku. 6. 38</ls>. .²2 To embrace. .²3 To put or lay round. .²4 To survey round, measure, range over. .²5 To throw over or beyond. .²6 To throw or put into. .²7 To fetter, chain. .²8 To deride; प्रणयाच्चाभिमानाच्च परिचिक्षेप राघवम् <ls>Rām. 2. 30. 2</ls>.
